name: fugu-status
description: Shows Claude Code context usage (via fugu) in the VS Code status bar for the official Claude Code extension.

fuguStatus.pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to refresh context usage, in seconds.

fuguStatus.fuguContextPath.description: Path to the fugu-context binary. Default assumes it is on PATH.

fuguStatus.fuguBurnPath.description: Path to the fugu-burn binary. Default assumes it is on PATH.

fuguStatus.showCost.description: Show today's estimated cost for this workspace next to context usage.

fuguStatus.costPollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to refresh cost, in seconds. Cost scans more data than context, so this defaults slower.

fuguStatus.fuguAccountsPath.description: Path to the fugu-accounts binary. Default assumes it is on PATH.

fuguStatus.fuguSessionsPath.description: Path to the fugu-sessions binary. Default assumes it is on PATH.
